role: cluster E lead — git-failure refusal (E1), LC_ALL=C pin (E2), unique-commit skew (E3)
host: git 2.55.0; TMPDIR pinned to /var/tmp (host /tmp carries a disk quota)
isolation: Every fixture is a fresh mktemp -d under /var/tmp. No live fleet path, lane repo file, or installed tool was written: the four installed sha256 values above were re-hashed after all runs and are unchanged. Fixtures are removed by EXIT trap.

defect_classes.title: Any git command failure must refuse — never be counted as zero

sites.what: count_live_refs: unreadable scan scope returned refs=0; try_pushed compared a `|| true` pipeline to "0" so a failing history query read as no unpushed commits; evaluate_repo_root piped a failing log through wc -l
count_live_refs: same scope bug; try_pushed: same history-query laundering; evaluate_repo_root: same log|wc -l laundering

count_worktrees/count_unpushed/scratch_bytes: `|| printf 0` turned a git failure into a clean zero; new flags worktrees-unverifiable, unpushed-unverifiable, scratch-unverifiable and has_problem now includes them, so a failed query can never publish `clean`

git_dirty_tracked ended in `|| true`, so a failing status read as an empty (clean) porcelain and the dirty-tracked gate2 was skipped; the call site now routes a failure to NOT-AUTHORIZED(dirty-unverifiable)

commands: bash tools/souji-census.sh --root <fleet>   # repo with refs/heads/broken -> missing object
SHOKUNIN_ROOT=<fleet> bash tools/souji-verify.sh <repo>/target.txt   # broken branch ref
baseline_observed: verify/vault: SAFE(stale) refs=0 for the SAME artifact that is NOT-SAFE(live-refs=1) with a correct root
census: row published as `clean` while `git rev-list` exited 128
quarantine: RESULT DELETED pushed — the tracked directory was deleted; original bundle gone
candidate_observed: quarantine: NOT-AUTHORIZED dirty-unverifiable 'r7-gate2 status query failed'; bundle retained
verify: NOT-SAFE pushed-unverifiable 'history-query-failed'; vault: NOT-VERIFIED(none) with the same evidence token

defect_classes.title: Pin LC_ALL=C for case-sensitive matching including id_*

sites.what: no LC_ALL at entry and the secret-name fold used awk tolower(), which honors LC_CTYPE; now exports LC_ALL=C and folds A-Z by byte with an index()-based ascii_lower()

fresh_repro.fixture: privately compiled tr_TR locale via localedef --no-archive, LOCPATH-isolated; sentinel <repo>/.scratch/ID_SENTINEL.log
fresh_repro.baseline_observed: census flags clean,scratch (secret-shaped flag LOST under tr_TR); under C it is clean,scratch,secret-shaped
fresh_repro.candidate_observed: census flags dirty,scratch,secret-shaped under tr_TR, and the whole TSV is byte-identical to the C-locale run (cmp -s)

defect_classes.note: verify, vault and quarantine already export LC_ALL=C at entry, so the E2 defect never reproduced there; their R9 Turkish-locale checks were re-run and still pass (verify R9 16/16, vault R9 16/16, quarantine R9 28/28).

defect_classes.title: Unique-commit count must exclude the candidate's own linked-worktree HEAD

sites.what: `log --oneline <head> --not --all | wc -l` replaced with `rev-list --count <head> --not <durable for-each-ref objects> --`; evidence gains durable-refs-only=yes
same replacement, keeping the R_REASON plumbing

fresh_repro.fixture: detached linked worktree holding a private commit, directory removed, registration kept (dir=absent)
fresh_repro.baseline_observed: verify SAFE(metadata-prune) unique=0; vault VERIFIED(metadata-prune); following the receipt with fixture-only worktree prune + gc --prune=now destroys the commit (cat-file -e <priv>^{commit} fails)
fresh_repro.candidate_observed: verify NOT-SAFE none unique=1 durable-refs-only=yes; vault NOT-VERIFIED(none) with the same evidence; the pushed detached registration (wt-f4) still earns SAFE(metadata-prune)/VERIFIED(metadata-prune), so the fix does not over-refuse

cand-e1-verify.sh: RE3/RE3b private commit -> NOT-SAFE unique=1 durable-refs-only=yes
RE3c pushed detached registration -> SAFE(metadata-prune) control
cand-e1-vault.sh: RE1 same -> NOT-VERIFIED(none) with history-query-failed evidence
cand-e1-census.sh: row count 5 (fixtures grew by the broken-ref repo)
cand-e1-quarantine.sh: R10-E1 status shim -> rc=3, dirty-unverifiable, target retained

verification.method: Each defect was reproduced on the UNMODIFIED installed tool first (baseline), then the same fixture construction was run against the candidate. Both halves are asserted in tools/cand-e1-regress.sh, so a check fails if either the baseline stops reproducing or the candidate stops refusing.
commands: TMPDIR=/var/tmp bash tools/cand-e1-verify.sh --selftest      # 45 checks, 0 failed + ROUND9 16/0
TMPDIR=/var/tmp bash tools/cand-e1-vault.sh --selftest       # 56 checks, 0 failed + ROUND9 16/0
TMPDIR=/var/tmp bash tools/cand-e1-quarantine.sh --selftest  # 94 checks, 0 failed + ROUND9 28/0
verification.fail_closed: Every new refusal is a refusal, not a new acceptance. No candidate was observed to delete, stage, or authorise anything the baseline refused, and no protected content was read: the secret-shaped fixtures are empty/plain files never opened by the tools.

caveats: E2 did not reproduce in verify/vault/quarantine — those three already exported LC_ALL=C. The census fix is the whole E2 delta, and it is corroborated by the tr_TR byte-identity check.

The r4 vault reason vocabulary has no `pushed-unverifiable`, so its E1 history-query refusal surfaces as NOT-VERIFIED(none) with `pushed=unverifiable(history-query-failed)` in the evidence rather than a new reason string. Adding one would change the documented reason list; left for the composer to decide.
tools/cand-e1-regress.sh is S09's own harness, not an installed tool; it writes only its own /var/tmp fixtures.
Sites beyond the assigned cluster E (e.g. quarantine's stage-4 second-check path, the S18 guard candidate) were not modified.
handoff_to_composer: cand-e1-{verify,vault,census,quarantine}.sh are drop-in full-source replacements for the four installed tools with cluster E closed. The composer should re-run the four --selftest batteries plus tools/cand-e1-regress.sh on the frozen merge bytes; a lost PASS or a baseline that stops reproducing invalidates the corresponding claim.
